name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: Along Westfall's shore, Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure begins with a battered parchment map. It sends you searching for his personal footlocker, then onward toward his hidden plunder across the region.

sections.title: A Sailor's Last Bequest
sections.body: Captain Sanders was an old seafarer who met a watery grave off Westfall's western coast. He left cryptic instructions so his hard-won fortune would not be lost to the Great Sea or taken by scavengers. You can retrace the trail he left behind. Shipwrecks and the restless spirits of drowned sailors mark the western shore.

sections.title: The Rusty Anchor
sections.body: A lone rusty anchor in the surf marks the first clue on Westfall's western coast. Near a wreck, half-buried in the sand, lies Captain Sanders' old footlocker, battered by the waves. Inside are seawater, sand, and a scurrying crab clutching the next piece of Sanders' puzzle.

faq.answer: Captain Sanders was an old sea captain whose map says he lies in a watery grave. He left the map and a series of clues leading to his hidden plunder.
The footlocker lies half-buried in the sand along Westfall's western coast, near a solitary rusty anchor by the shoreline.

faq.q: Does the footlocker contain the captain's treasure?
faq.answer: The map leads you to a footlocker and the next clue in a longer treasure hunt.

faq.q: How many clues are in Captain Sanders' treasure hunt?
faq.answer: The hunt has four steps across Westfall's coast and countryside. It begins with the map and ends with Captain Sanders' actual treasure chest on an island off the coast.

faq.q: Why did Captain Sanders bury his treasure in Westfall?
faq.answer: Captain Sanders' map never says why he chose Westfall. It says he expected to meet a watery grave and wanted whoever followed his clues to find his treasure. The clues are spread across the coast and the bluffs above it.

faq.q: Can Horde players follow this treasure map?
faq.answer: Yes. Captain Sanders' map and clues are neutral, so any adventurer who reaches Westfall's coast can follow his trail.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know the value of following a dead sailor's map along a lawless coast. A pirate's treasure hunt suits scoundrels and privateers.
As an Alliance adventurer, recovering a fortune from Westfall's wreck-strewn coast is a small victory amid the kingdom's frontier turmoil. Coastal murlocs menace the shore.
